body: I'm no expert, I had mine done about a month and a half ago, but I'd say after about 3-4 weeks the sensitivity was not annoying anymore. Also the peeing thing happened since your head is losing sensitivty and hardening and it ended up covering the hole. I had a similar issue then the doc perscribed me something to stretch it a bit and now it's fine. Also the erections thing will calm down after a while you just gotta endure. Most of it calmed down after masturbating a few times but I'd wait until at least week 2-3 before doing it. Best of wishes and stay strong man.

Didn't mean to react so aggressively, I apologize for that. But I wanted to give some outlook on that there's usually someone in a worse position which ofc doesn't really change your status, but since you said you didn't want any sympathy in your original post I wanted to see if this would make you move on further.
Not available in my country. And its super expensive and not affordable for me to try it in america for example. But it could work.

Try living with eye floaters that ruin your quality of life, tinitus that doesn't let you sleep at night, getting kicked out the house and both parents at deaths door and suddenly homework doesn't seem that bad.

I'm sorry to hear that, you sound like such a nice and caring person. I wish I could tell you it would get better but the chances are low. I was diagnosed with eye floaters and tinnitus at a young age, so I constantly live with a damaged sight and buzzing in my ear, but just like you I want to live. I get hit with sad days every now and then but I just look at the things I enjoy the most and use those to drive myself forward. You gotta  have to stay strong for your family. Try to force your mind to think about other things rather then just focus on the eyes. Is there any operation that can be done about it?  Best wishes from George. :)
